edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 44,000,000 for the Shares at Closing.

2. Closing. Closing shall occur within 45 days of signing, subject to completion of customary diligence, financing arrangements, and satisfaction or waiver of the conditions set forth in this Agreement.

3. Representations. The Seller represents, as of signing and as of Closing, that: (a) it has full power and authority to enter into and perform this Agreement; (b) it holds good and valid title to the Shares, free and clear of any liens or encumbrances; (c) except as disclosed in writing to the Buyer, the Company has no material undisclosed liabilities; (d) the Company is in material compliance with applicable laws; (e) there is no pending or, to the Seller’s knowledge, threatened litigation that would materially adversely affect the Company or the Shares; (f) the Company has timely filed and paid, in all material respects, all taxes due; and (g) the capitalization of the Company is as set forth in the disclosure schedule delivered to the Buyer.

4. Confidentiality. The terms of this Agreement are confidential, provided that the Buyer and its representatives may disclose such terms and related information to the extent reasonably necessary for due diligence, financing, internal approvals, legal, accounting, and tax compliance, and as otherwise required by law, regulation, or court order, subject to customary confidentiality obligations where practicable.

5. Indemnity; Survival. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses arising from any breach of the Seller’s representations, warranties, or covenants, subject to a basket equal to 1% of the purchase price, a cap equal to 10% of the purchase price (except for fraud, willful misconduct, title to the Shares, and authority, which shall not be subject to the cap), and a survival period of 12 months following Closing for general claims, 24 months for tax matters, and applicable statutory periods for fraud claims.

Best leverage is to press for a further price reduction and broader seller protection package while preserving momentum toward signing.

receiver.requested_changes:
1) Price: reduce the purchase price further from USD 44,000,000 to USD 42,500,000, or, at minimum, add a post-closing working capital / leakage adjustment in Buyer’s favor.
2) Closing: shorten the outside date to 30 days from signing, with Buyer having the right to extend only for unresolved seller deliverables; diligence/financing should not be open-ended conditions.
3) Representations: add full standard reps on capitalization, no undisclosed liabilities, compliance, taxes, litigation, title, authority, absence of undisclosed related-party transactions, and no material adverse change between signing and closing; require bring-down at closing with materiality scrape.
4) Indemnity: remove the 1% basket and 10% cap for fundamental reps and fraud, and materially increase the cap for general reps to at least 25% of purchase price; extend general survival to 18 months and tax to 36 months.
5) Confidentiality: limit carveouts to actual need-to-know disclosures, require prior notice where legally permissible, and add an explicit prohibition on publicity and contact with employees/customers without Buyer consent.
6) Disclosure schedule: require complete delivery before signing and make clear that only specifically disclosed items qualify as exceptions to reps.
